subject.callable: direct Triton float16 LoRA A projection into a float32 output buffer
subject.boundary: one launch with one program per token, rank coordinate and slice; every output coordinate is overwritten

tasks.task_statement: Compute the complete two-slice LoRA A projection for 64 tokens, four LoRAs, rank 8 and hidden size 32 from finite contiguous float16 x and weights, scaling 0.5, an explicit token mapping containing -1 and valid ids, and a float32 output pre-state that the active call completely overwrites.

input_map.basis: the kernel multiplies every active A projection by the exact binary value 0.5
the wrapper requires float16 x and weights
the wrapper requires a float32 output pre-state and post-state
